data.description: Any creature struck by a basidirond's slam attack is coated with spores. The creature struck must make a DC %1 Fortitude save or these spores take root in his flesh, and particularly in his lungs. Basidirond Spores: Disease--inhaled; save Fort DC 16; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Con damage; cure 1 save.
